import gspread
import os

filerecords="/home/gspread/records.txt"
gc=gspread.service_account("/home/gspread/nxtgen-registration-0a2f85482a36.json")
responses="Student Registration for 2025-2026 (Responses)"
h=gc.open(responses).sheet1
raw=h.get_all_records()
if os.path.isfile(filerecords):
	f=open(filerecords, 'r')
	pre_records=f.readline()
	pre_records=int(pre_records)
	if  pre_records < len(raw):
		j=raw[len(raw)-len(pre_records):len(raw)]


records=str(len(h.get_all_records()))
f=open(filerecords, 'w')
f.write(records)
f.close()
